Print status widget: design options

For issue #111: a Home Screen widget that shows what the Lock Screen Live Activity shows, for people without push. Every option below reuses the activity's own parts: the cover that builds up with the print, the % capsule, the big countdown, the finish time and layer count, the 20-segment bar and the temperature chips. Drawn at iPhone 6.9" widget sizes on the same black card.

Without push the app refreshes the widget only when it runs (opened, or a background refresh), so a few things can't move on their own. The countdown always ticks on-device. Options marked live bar trade the 20 printer-reported segments for a bar that fills by time on its own, so it doesn't sit still between refreshes.

Also to decide

  1. Which printer: chosen per widget in Edit Widget, like the AMS widget, or automatically whichever print finishes soonest.
  2. Progress: printer-reported (M1: exact but frozen between refreshes) or time-based (M2: moves on its own, an estimate).
  3. When nothing is printing: the last print's cover with "Finished 2h ago", or "Idle" with the printer name.
